conclusion.decisive_invariant: For 43 of 44 affected jets, the complete float32 interval of stored ECF1 lies above the maximum scalar-pT sum allowed by every released constituent rounding cell. Because ECF1 is exactly sum(pt), arithmetic order, rapidity, clustering, and ECF formula choices cannot create that missing scalar pT.
conclusion.signed_bias_statement: The strict-failure rows are one-sided: reconstructed-stored is negative for 147/153 rows and positive for 6/153. ECF3 is negative for 40/40 independent affected jets.  The bulk medians over all 14,103 jets remain near zero, so this is a rare missing-information tail, not a global scale bias.
conclusion.control_summary: The recoverable C++-order float64 ECF replay changed the current results by at most 6.56e-14 relative and fixed 0 failures. Float32 accumulation, float32 rapidity with float64 accumulation, and float64 geometry with float32 accumulation also fixed 0 failures. Raw-energy rapidity fixed 0. The massless/eta control moved a few rows inside tolerance but contradicts the sourced rapidity definition and did not repair the ECF1 sum invariant. Thirteen constituent orderings fixed 0 failures. The independent full-rescan exclusive-kt replay differed by at most 2.63e-13 relative, fixed 0, and found no merge gap below 1e-6. Physically valid deterministic float32-cell controls accounted for the lone Qw-only jet; the other 43 jets retain a disjoint ECF1 input/output interval. All 9 failed C2 and all 4 failed D2 rows are self-consistent with their stored ECF branches, so they are propagated ECF discrepancies. For generalized ECFs, the source-like replay agrees at 4.32e-16 relative for L2 and exactly for L3; all 6 L2 failures and all 4 L3 failures occur on class-3 jets.
conclusion.objective_freeze_criterion: Freeze reconstruction when (i) authoritative formulas and units are unchanged; (ii) source-like double accumulation and an independent full-rescan clustering replay reveal zero class-1 mismatches; (iii) every strict residual is either reproduced by a deterministic numerical/degeneracy control or linked to a violated input invariant outside the combined float32 cells; and (iv) no jet remains class 4.  Do not require zero strict rows when the released constituents demonstrably lack information used by the stored high-level branch.
